name: Phone call
kid: The modem turns the parcel into whistles and hisses and sends them down the phone line, like a very fast, very noisy phone call.
nerd: A V.34 modem call: up to 28.8 kbit/s each way, in practice less (33.6k came in 1996, 56k in 1997; standardised as V.90 in 1998). The call holds one circuit through the exchange for as long as you are online.
